pages.name: American Paint
pages.text: Bold patchwork coats are the signature. American Paints carry the same all-purpose build as the Quarter Horse, but the dramatic $(thing)white field$() pattern makes every individual unmistakable.

pages.title: Coat
pages.text: Always with $(thing)White Field$() markings:$(br2)$(li)Brown + White Field$()$(li)Black + White Field$()$(li)Chestnut + White Field$()$(li)Dark Brown + White Field$()$(li)White + White Field$()$(li)Creamy + White Field$()
